text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Lunch break is coming to an end, yet<n>Rice Shower is
still at the plaza...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nothing like that... We're playing<n>hide and seek,
but I just haven't<n>found her yet.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to just throw in the towel... but<n>then what's
the point in playing?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And if I do that, Urara won't play with<n>me anymore.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So I have to find her before the bell<n>rings at the end
of lunch... No matter<n>what!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Persistent in her search, Rice Shower<n>is able to find
Haru Urara, but not<n>without tiring herself out.
